capabilities.name: agent-native
capabilities.purpose: Make an out-of-session Claude (Managed Agent or Agent SDK loop) AgentOps-native — via skills + the ao CLI + CI, not hooks.

capabilities.name: autodev
capabilities.purpose: Manage the PROGRAM.md/AUTODEV.md contract that drives the loop — the config layer Evolve and Factory read each tick, not a loop itself.

capabilities.name: automation-shape-routing
capabilities.purpose: Front door for agent automation — decide the SHAPE (Workflow vs NTM vs skill), then hand off. Triggers: "build automation", "convert skills to workflows", "which shape".

capabilities.name: bd-first-memory-migration
capabilities.purpose: Consolidate fragmented agent-memory layers into one bd-canonical store, then GC/retire the rest. Triggers: "memory migration", "consolidate agent memory", "beads-first memory".

capabilities.name: beads
capabilities.purpose: Track issues with bd/br, triage with bv, and convert plans to beads.

capabilities.name: burndown
capabilities.purpose: Drive a finite epic set to all-merged, then stop.

capabilities.name: curate
capabilities.purpose: Mine transcripts, .agents, bd, and git for skill diffs, bd updates, or

capabilities.name: doc
capabilities.purpose: Generate and validate repo docs (default), READMEs (--mode=readme), and OSS doc packs (--mode=oss).

capabilities.name: domain
capabilities.purpose: Canonical vocabulary for human-AI software work.

capabilities.name: dream
capabilities.purpose: Retired pointer — out-of-session compounding moved to the substrate (NTM + MCP + managed-agents).

capabilities.name: eval-outcomes
capabilities.purpose: Grade against Outcomes as a holdout-safe projection of the locked eval substrate — one bar, many runtimes.

capabilities.name: operating-loop-workflow
capabilities.purpose: Install and run the operating-loop multi-agent Workflow (the seven-move loop) for AgentOps plugin users.

capabilities.name: review
capabilities.purpose: Review diffs for risk, find mocks, scan for bugs, and audit codebases.

capabilities.name: scaffold
capabilities.purpose: Create project, component, or boilerplate scaffolds.

capabilities.name: scope
capabilities.purpose: Hard-block edits outside declared frozen directories via PreToolUse hook.

capabilities.name: session-bootstrap
capabilities.purpose: Universal init prompt — every agent spawned into an AgentOps repo runs `ao session bootstrap` first.

capabilities.name: ship-loop
capabilities.purpose: Bot-paired fast-lane cycle for coherent-arc internal PRs (one closable bead or small-epic slice): claim → test → impl → pre-push → push → squash auto-merge → close.

capabilities.name: skill-auditor
capabilities.purpose: Audit an existing SKILL.md against the unified AgentOps template (15

capabilities.name: skill-builder
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold or absorb new SKILL.md files against the unified AgentOps template. Triggers: "create a skill", "scaffold skill", "absorb external skill", "new skill".

capabilities.name: system-tuning
capabilities.purpose: Restore system responsiveness via safe, ordered process cleanup and agent-swarm

capabilities.name: validate
capabilities.purpose: Produce PASS/WARN/FAIL verdicts for artifacts, plans, code, PRs, or gates.

capabilities.name: workflow-builder
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold a new Claude Workflow script — deterministic multi-agent orchestration. Triggers: "build a workflow", "create a workflow", "scaffold workflow", "author a workflow".
